title: Months of the Year Song (Tiny Sparks original)

lines.text: January, February, March and April too,
May and June and July, August, sing it through!
Twelve months in a year, come on and remember!
January, February, March and April too,
May and June and July, August, sing it through!
Twelve months in a year, come on and remember!
January, February, March and April too,
May and June and July, August, sing it through!
Twelve months in a year, come on and remember!
When's your birthday? Can you say?
Shout your month, hip hip hooray!
January, February, March and April too,
May and June and July, August, sing it through!
Twelve months in a year, come on and remember!
